─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Coverage limitations / explicit deferrals
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

UI-RED-04 multi-page coverage: the present test creates three marks
on a single page (all rect-based, no actual search). True multi-page
search-and-redact requires:
  - SearchEngine integration to locate query matches across pages.
  - markRange iteration over each match's per-page bbox.
  - RedactionManager.applyAll across all pages.
The component-level invariants (createMark, applyAll, count tracking)
are fully covered. The cross-component search-->markRange wiring is
deferred to Phase D1 final integration, where SearchEngine + UI
event-loop are co-located.

UI-IMG-03 / UI-IMG-11 (EXIF strip on insert / batch strip): EXIF
stripping is unit-tested in test_exif_stripper.cpp (existing). The
UI-integration path (insert with strip-on flag, batch strip across
all images) is deferred to Phase D1.
